name: wayfinder
description: Shows where the open file sits in the codebase: what imports it, what it imports, its members, its tests and what is missing.

commands.title: Wayfinder: Show map for this file

wayfinder.ai.instructions.markdownDescription:
**Your rules for Scan with AI.** Type them in the box below, one rule per line. Wayfinder adds them to every scan. Only you get these rules.

Examples:
- `Flag every function longer than 40 lines.`
- `Flag any use of the any type.`
- `Point out functions with no error handling around network calls.`

To share rules with your team, put them in `.wayfinder/rules.md` and commit it. [Create or open the rules file](command:wayfinder.createAiRules)

Wayfinder adds the team rules first, then yours, after its built-in rules. Together they are cut at 2,000 characters.

wayfinder.ai.model.markdownDescription:
Model for Scan with AI. [Choose a model](command:wayfinder.chooseAiModel)

Or type an Ollama model such as `qwen2.5-coder:1.5b`, or `claude-code` or `codex` to scan through that CLI in the cloud. Leave empty to turn AI off.

enumDescriptions: Also send the code of the open file's direct imports, callers and tests, cut to fit the model.
